ORI (Ocean Recommendation Integration) Dataset
	


	
		
		Overview
	

This dataset contains consolidated model metrics used by the ORI (Ocean Recommendation Integration) 
system for AI model recommendations. The data includes performance metrics across various benchmarks,
speed measurements, and cost information for different AI models and providers.
